scope: Source weight/max-weight ownership, producer packets and ordinary actor-skill weight eligibility, compared with current port state and receivers.

source_fields_and_producers.detail: Receive dispatcher packet 176 (0x00B0) calls CGameMode::Zc_Par_Change; packet 177 calls Zc_Longpar_Change. Zc_Par_Change reads the parameter ID from WORD at buf+2 and a 32-bit value at buf+4. The selected PE proves that the 32-bit wire value is interpreted as signed before division by 10 (see VA range below); the decompiler's DWORD expression does not preserve this signedness.

Zc_Par_Change parameter 0x18 updates g_session.m_weight and parameter 0x19 updates g_session.m_maxWeight. The selected PE sequence `mov 66666667; imul; sar edx,2; sign correction` implements signed 32-bit division by 10 (truncating toward zero); therefore both assignments use reinterpret_s32(wireDWORD)/10, not unsigned DWORD division. They are separate self-session values in source CSession, with wire values scaled by 10.

CSession initialization sets m_maxWeight and m_weight to zero. The selected packet arithmetic proves signed integer division for their wire updates; a member declaration/type was not found in the available Ref/Session.h text.

source_actor_eligibility.detail: Before ordinary actor-target processing, the source clamps the denominator to 1 when m_maxWeight <= 1, then checks 100*m_weight/denominator >= 90. At/over the threshold it shows MSI_NO_ATTACK_OVERWEIGHT and returns before the normal actor skill message path. These guards are skipped when the selected skill ID is 10000. Similar repeated guards occur in additional actor/PC and companion branches.

port_state_and_receivers.detail: No player m_weight/m_maxWeight fields, getters, or setters are present in the current CSession implementation.

Port registers 0x00B0 and 0x00B1 to HandleSelfStatusParam. That handler currently parses status type from bytes 2-3 and a u32 value from bytes 4-7, then passes it through ApplySelfStatusUpdate/ApplySelfStatusUpdateToSession. The session updater has no cases for source parameter IDs 0x18/0x19, so these signed-scaled weight values are not retained. The 0x00BE handler is a different status-point-cost path and is not the source weight producer.
HandleCartInfo parses cart weight and maxWeight as DWORDs at +6/+10 but only logs them; these are cart data and do not supply the source player CSession weight fields.

The port pending actor-skill click path arms/dispatches actor skill intent without player weight/maxWeight state or the source >=90% rejection guard. A nearby comment says source player41 has guards, though the ordinary eligibility decision occurs in the source ProcessObjClick caller before message 41; capture has a separate 10000 exception.

gaps_and_questions: Port packet framing already routes 0x00B0 through HandleSelfStatusParam, but the source IDs 0x18 (weight) and 0x19 (max weight) are not mapped into persistent session state; source /10 scaling and status threshold presentation are consequently absent from this receive path.

Without persistent player weight values, the port cannot reproduce source ordinary actor-skill eligibility checks at 90%. Whether to also reproduce the source 50% notification transitions is outside this bounded actor-eligibility audit.

Historical unsigned interpretation from the decompiled DWORD expression is superseded by the selected PE arithmetic at 0x59708F-0x5970A3. For negative wire values the source performs signed division by 10 with truncation toward zero; root owns the port conversion and arithmetic implementation.
root_review: Baseline inventory before this implementation; signed decode supersedes the misleading decompiler DWORD spelling. See PK27-source-pending-source-review.json.
